description_en: Retrieves the details of an approval instance for your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下审批实例详情
name: GetApproval

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approval instance. You can obtain the ID from the following sources:

[ListApprovals](~~ListApprovals~~): Queries a list of approval instances.

[GetApproval](~~GetApproval~~): Queries the details of an approval instance
parameters.help_zh:
审批实例ID。取值来源：
[ListApprovals](~~ListApprovals~~)：批量查询审批实例列表。
[GetApproval](~~GetApproval~~)：查询审批实例详情
parameters.name: approval_id

ApprovalDetail.description_en: The details of the approval instance
ApprovalDetail.example: {"initiatorName":"王先生","initiatorDept":"测试部","devType":"windows","deviceType":"usbStorage","deviceId":"FC216E9E3****","approvalEndTimestamp":1736524799,"approvalReason":"这是一个测试"}

ApprovalId.description_en: The ID of the approval instance

ApprovalProgresses.description_en: A list of progress nodes for the approval instance
ApprovalProgresses.description_zh: 审批实例进展节点列表

items.description_en: A progress node for the approval instance

Action.description_en:
The action performed on the progress node. Valid values:

Approve: Approve

Reject: Reject

Revoke: Revoke

Comment: Comment
Action.description_zh:
审批进展节点执行操作。取值：
Approve：通过。
Reject：拒绝。
Revoke：撤回。
Comment：评论

Comment.description_en: The comment for the action on the progress node
Comment.description_zh: 审批进展节点执行评论

Executor.description_en: The ID of the executor for the progress node

Operators.description_en: A list of operators for the progress node
Operators.description_zh: 审批进展节点操作人列表

items.description_en: The operator of the progress node

SaseUserId.description_en: The ID of the operator for the progress node

Username.description_en: The username of the operator for the progress node
Username.description_zh: 审批进展节点操作人用户名

Status.description_en:
The status of the progress node. Valid values:

Pending: Pending

Approved: Approved

Rejected: Rejected

Revoked: Revoked
Status.description_zh:
审批进展节点状态。取值：
Pending：待审批。
Approved：已通过。
Rejected：已拒绝。
Revoked：已撤回

Timestamp.description_en: The time when the action was performed on the progress node. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 审批进展节点执行时刻，秒级时间戳

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the approval instance was created

CreatorDepartment.description_en: The department of the user who created the approval instance

CreatorDevTag.description_en: The ID of the client device from which the approval instance was created
CreatorDevTag.description_zh: 审批实例创建终端设备ID

CreatorUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the approval instance

CreatorUsername.description_en: The username of the user who created the approval instance
CreatorUsername.description_zh: 审批实例创建人用户名

EndTimestamp.description_en: The expiration time of the approval instance. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTimestamp.description_zh: 审批实例有效截止时刻，秒级时间戳

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the associated policy. Valid values:

DomainBlacklist: Domain blacklist

DomainWhitelist: Domain whitelist

SoftwareBlock: Software block

AppUninstall: Client uninstall

DlpSend: Outbound file transfer

PeripheralBlock: Peripheral control
PolicyType.description_zh:
审批实例关联策略类型。取值：
DomainBlacklist：域名黑名单。
DomainWhitelist：域名白名单。
SoftwareBlock：软件禁用。
AppUninstall：终端卸载。
DlpSend：文件外发。
PeripheralBlock：外设管控

ProcessId.description_en: The ID of the associated approval flow

ProcessName.description_en: The name of the associated approval flow
ProcessName.description_zh: 审批实例关联流程名称

Reason.description_en: The reason for creating the approval instance

SchemaContent.description_en: The content of the associated template
SchemaContent.description_zh: 审批实例关联模板内容

SchemaId.description_en: The ID of the associated template

SchemaName.description_en: The name of the associated template
SchemaName.description_zh: 审批实例关联模板名称

Status.description_en:
The status of the approval instance. Valid values:

Pending: Pending

Approved: Approved

Rejected: Rejected

Revoked: Revoked

Expired: Expired
Status.description_zh:
审批实例状态。取值：
Pending：待审批。
Approved：已通过。
Rejected：已拒绝。
Revoked：已撤回。
Expired：已过期
